normalise_rules: collapse all whitespace incl. newlines to one space, trim (e.g. "Cisco\nC9200L-48T-4X-E" -> "Cisco C9200L-48T-4X-E")
canonical vendor case on first token: DELL/dell->Dell, cisco/CISCO->Cisco, JUNIPER->Juniper, Paloalto->Palo Alto, riverbed->Riverbed
Fortinet variants (Fortinet_FG100D, FortinetFG-60F, Fortinet FortiGate 101F, Fortinet-FG-101F, FG-101F, FortiGate 100D-1/-2) -> "Fortinet FG-<model>"

Cisco licence/feature suffix dropped where hardware is identical: C9200L-48T-4X-E -> C9200L-48T-4X; C9300-48T-E/-A -> C9300-48T; C9300X-24Y-A/-E -> C9300X-24Y; ISR4451-X-AX/K9 and "ISR4451-X Router" -> ISR4451-X; WS-C3850-48T-E -> WS-C3850-48T
Cisco descriptive suffixes dropped: N9K-C93108TC-EX-48-UTP / -48p -> N9K-C93108TC-EX; N9K-C93180YC-EX-48p -> N9K-C93180YC-EX; "Nexus 3548 Chassis"/"NEXUS-3548-SW" -> Nexus 3548
Cisco typos fixed: WS-C2960X-24TDL -> WS-C2960X-24TD-L; "Catalyst C2960X-48TD-L" -> WS-C2960X-48TD-L; WS-C2960+48TC-L -> WS-C2960plus-48TC-L
Product-family names: "ProLiant DL360 Gen10" -> HPE DL360 Gen10; "PowerEdge R6525" -> Dell R6525
IBM/Lenovo System x same hardware merged: "IBM x3650 M5", "Lenovo X3650M5" -> Lenovo x3650 M5; "Lenovo X3550 M5" -> Lenovo x3550 M5
Oracle: "Oracle Exadata X7" and "Oracle Exadata Exadata X7-2 HC" -> Oracle Exadata X7-2
Storage: "IBM Storage-FS5300" -> IBM FlashSystem 5300; "EMC UnityXT480F" -> EMC Unity XT 480F; "EMC UnityXT380" -> EMC Unity XT 380
Generic descriptions (HPE Server, EMC Storage, IBM San Switch, DELL, IBM AS400, (VM)) kept as-is and flagged is_generic_description
